quranTranslation.text: And when there cometh unto them a messenger from Allah, confirming that which they possess, a party of those who have received the Scripture fling the Scripture of Allah behind their backs as if they knew not,
And when We gave unto Moses the Scripture and the criterion (of right and wrong), that ye might be led aright.
Establish worship, pay the poor-due, and bow your heads with those who bow (in worship).

And We caused Jesus, son of Mary, to follow in their footsteps, confirming that which was (revealed) before him in the Torah, and We bestowed on him the Gospel wherein is guidance and a light, confirming that which was (revealed) before it in the Torah - a guidance and an admonition unto those who ward off (evil).
Those unto whom We have given the Scripture, who read it with the right reading, those believe in it. And whoso disbelieveth in it, those are they who are the losers.

And verily We gave unto Moses the Scripture and We caused a train of messengers to follow after him, and We gave unto Jesus, son of Mary, clear proofs (of Allah's sovereignty), and We supported him with the Holy spirit. Is it ever so, that, when there cometh unto you a messenger (from Allah) with that which ye yourselves desire not, ye grow arrogant, and some ye disbelieve and some ye slay?
So as to deny that which We have given them. Then enjoy life (while ye may), for ye will come to know.

Jubilant (are they) because of that which Allah hath bestowed upon them of His bounty, rejoicing for the sake of those who have not joined them but are left behind: That there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.
Your guardian can be only Allah; and His messenger and those who believe, who establish worship and pay the poordue, and bow down (in prayer).
Recite unto them the tale of him to whom We gave Our revelations, but he sloughed them off, so Satan overtook him and he became of those who lead astray.

And when ye have completed your devotions, then remember Allah as ye remember your fathers or with a more lively remembrance. But of mankind is he who saith: "Our Lord! Give unto us in the world," and he hath no portion in the Hereafter.
Lo! those who believe and do good works and establish worship and pay the poor-due, their reward is with their Lord and there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.

And (remember, O Children of Israel) when We made a covenant with you and caused the mount to tower above you, (saying): Hold fast that which We have given you, and remember that which is therein, that ye may ward off (evil).
Who giveth his wealth that he may grow (in goodness).

No soul can ever die except by Allah's leave and at a term appointed. Whoso desireth the reward of the world, We bestow on him thereof; and whoso desireth the reward of the Hereafter, We bestow on him thereof. We shall reward the thankful.
Who give not the poor-due, and who are disbelievers in the Hereafter.

Or are they jealous of mankind because of that which Allah of His bounty hath bestowed upon them? For We bestowed upon the house of Abraham (of old) the Scripture and wisdom, and We bestowed on them a mighty kingdom.

O Prophet! Say unto those captives who are in your hands: If Allah knoweth any good in your hearts He will give you better than that which hath been taken from you, and will forgive you. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
They are asking thee concerning the Spirit. Say: The Spirit is by command of my Lord, and of knowledge ye have been vouchsafed but little.
Ask of the Children of Israel how many a clear revelation We gave them! He who altereth the grace of Allah after it hath come unto him (for him), lo! Allah is severe in punishment.
And guard yourselves against a day when no soul will in aught avail another, nor will intercession be accepted from it, nor will compensation be received from it, nor will they be helped.

gloss.en: to be mindful (of God), to fear

quranTranslation.text: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: Will ye not then keep duty (unto Him)?

gloss.en: to be mindful (of God), to fear

quranTranslation.text: Those who believe and keep their duty (to Allah).

gloss.en: to be mindful (of God), to fear

quranTranslation.text: So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.

gloss.en: to be mindful (of God), to fear

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Observe your duty to Allah, and give up what remaineth (due to you) from usury, if ye are (in truth) believers.

gloss.en: to be mindful (of God), to fear

quranTranslation.text: Beautified is the life of the world for those who disbelieve; they make a jest of the believers. But those who keep their duty to Allah will be above them on the Day of Resurrection. Allah giveth without stint to whom He will.

gloss.en: to be mindful (of God), to fear

quranTranslation.text: Lo! Allah is with those who keep their duty unto Him and those who are doers of good.

gloss.en: to be mindful (of God), to fear

quranTranslation.text: And if they had believed and kept from evil, a recompense from Allah would be better, if they only knew.

gloss.en: to be mindful (of God), to fear

quranTranslation.text: They ask thee, (O Muhammad), of new moons, say: They are fixed seasons for mankind and for the pilgrimage. It is not righteousness that ye go to houses by the backs thereof (as do the idolaters at certain seasons), but the righteous man is he who wardeth off (evil). So go to houses by the gates thereof, and observe your duty to Allah, that ye may be successful.

gloss.en: to be mindful (of God), to fear

options.en: and so that you (all) may be mindful (of God)

quranTranslation.text: They said: Is it indeed thou who art Joseph? He said: I am Joseph and this is my brother. Allah hath shown us favour. Lo! he who wardeth off (evil) and endureth (findeth favour); for lo! Allah loseth not the wages of the kindly.

gloss.en: to be mindful (of God), to fear

options.en: and let him be mindful (of God)

quranTranslation.text: And when it is said unto him: Be careful of thy duty to Allah, pride taketh him to sin. Hell will settle his account, an evil resting-place.

gloss.en: to be mindful (of God), to fear

quranTranslation.text: As for him who giveth and is dutiful (toward Allah)

gloss.en: to be mindful (of God), to fear

and let him be mindful (of God)

quranTranslation.text: And let those fear (in their behaviour toward orphans) who if they left behind them weak offspring would be afraid for them. So let them mind their duty to Allah, and speak justly.

gloss.en: to be mindful (of God), to fear

options.en: and so that you (all) may be mindful (of God)

quranTranslation.text: Marvel ye that there should come unto you a Reminder from your Lord by means of a man among you, that he may warn you, and that ye may keep from evil, and that haply ye may find mercy.

gloss.en: to be mindful (of God), to fear

options.en: and so that you (all) may be mindful (of God)

quranTranslation.text: O ye wives of the Prophet! Ye are not like any other women. If ye keep your duty (to Allah), then be not soft of speech, lest he in whose heart is a disease aspire (to you), but utter customary speech.

gloss.en: to be mindful (of God), to fear

quranTranslation.text: It is no sin for them (thy wives) to converse freely) with their fathers, or their sons, or their brothers, or their brothers' sons, or the sons of their sisters or of their own women, or their slaves. O women! Keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is ever Witness over all things.

gloss.en: to be mindful (of God), to fear

quranTranslation.text: Is he then, who will strike his face against the awful doom upon the Day of Resurrection (as he who doeth right)? And it will be said unto the wrong-doers: Taste what ye used to earn.

gloss.en: to be mindful (of God), to fear

quranTranslation.text: Wherein they will abide, with no desire to be removed from thence.
Who debar (men) from the path of Allah and would have it crooked, and who are disbelievers in the Last Day.
Say: O People of the Scripture! Why drive ye back believers from the way of Allah, seeking to make it crooked, when ye are witnesses (to Allah's guidance)? Allah is not unaware of what ye do.

Say: Shall I seek another than Allah for Lord, when He is Lord of all things? Each soul earneth only on its own account, nor doth any laden bear another's load. Then unto your Lord is your return and He will tell you that wherein ye differed.

Lurk not on every road to threaten (wayfarers), and to turn away from Allah's path him who believeth in Him, and to seek to make it crooked. And remember, when ye were but few, how He did multiply you. And see the nature of the consequence for the corrupters!
He said: Shall I seek for you a god other than Allah when He hath favoured you above (all) creatures?

Had they gone forth among you they had added to you naught save trouble and had hurried to and fro among you, seeking to cause sedition among you; and among you there are some who would have listened to them. Allah is Aware of evil-doers.

And when they opened their belongings they discovered that their merchandise had been returned to them. They said: O our father! What (more) can we ask? Here is our merchandise returned to us. We shall get provision for our folk and guard our brother, and we shall have the extra measure of a camel (load). This (that we bring now) is a light measure.
He said: This is that which we have been seeking. So they retraced their steps again.
That (is so). And whoso hath retaliated with the like of that which he was made to suffer and then hath (again) been wronged, Allah will succour him. Lo! Allah verily is Mild, Forgiving.

Now Korah was of Moses' folk, but he oppressed them; and We gave him so much treasure that the stores thereof would verily have been a burden for a troop of mighty men. When his own folk said unto him: Exult not; lo! Allah loveth not the exultant;

How they burst in upon David, and he was afraid of them. They said: Be not afraid! (We are) two litigants, one of whom hath wronged the other, therefor judge aright between us; be not unjust; and show us the fair way.
The way (of blame) is only against those who oppress mankind, and wrongfully rebel in the earth. For such there is a painful doom.

And if two parties of believers fall to fighting, then make peace between them. And if one party of them doeth wrong to the other, fight ye that which doeth wrong till it return unto the ordinance of Allah; then, if it return, make peace between them justly, and act equitably. Lo! Allah loveth the equitable.
And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.
And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.
They cried, coming toward them: What is it ye have lost?
Ask the township where we were, and the caravan with which we travelled hither. Lo! we speak the truth.

Throw down thy staff. And when he saw it writhing as it had been a demon, he turned to flee headlong, (and it was said unto him): O Moses! Draw nigh and fear not. Lo! thou art of those who are secure.
And (his people) came toward him, hastening.
Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman!

options.en: and We will surely settle you (all)

quranTranslation.text: And verily We shall make you to dwell in the land after them. This is for him who feareth My Majesty and feareth My threats.

options.en: and We will surely settle you (all)

quranTranslation.text: Our Lord! Lo! I have settled some of my posterity in an uncultivable valley near unto Thy holy House, our Lord! that they may establish proper worship; so incline some hearts of men that they may yearn toward them, and provide Thou them with fruits in order that they may be thankful.
And we send down from the sky water in measure, and We give it lodging in the earth, and lo! We are Able to withdraw it.

options.en: and We will surely settle you (all)

quranTranslation.text: If He will He calmeth the wind so that they keep still upon its surface - Lo! herein verily are signs for every steadfast grateful (heart). -
